ios.desc:
Depthforge transforms your imagination into immersive spatial photos on Apple Vision Pro. Create stunning AI-generated images that come alive in your space using simple text prompts. Whether you're an artist, designer, or creative enthusiast, Depthforge opens up a new dimension of digital art creation with seamless integration into your Photos library.

REVOLUTIONARY SPATIAL PHOTO GENERATION

Experience the future of AI art creation with spatial photo generation technology. Your creations aren't just flat pictures - they're Apple Spatial Photos that you can view across all your devices. Simply describe what you want to see, and watch as Depthforge brings your vision to life with stunning depth.

BUILT FOR APPLE VISION PRO

Fully optimized spatial computing experience
Native Apple Spatial Photos support
Intuitive hand gesture controls for natural interaction
Position your creations anywhere in your space
Dynamic depth perception
Choose between landscape and portrait orientations

SPARK YOUR CREATIVITY

Built-in prompt generator for inspiration
AI-enhanced prompt system for better results
User-friendly interface designed for everyone
Save directly to Photos app as spatial photos
Organize and access your creations easily across devices

THE DEPTHFORGE DIFFERENCE

Unlike traditional image generators, Depthforge creates true spatial photos that integrate seamlessly with your Photos library. We've developed sophisticated technology to ensure your generated artwork maintains depth coherence as you move and view it across all your Apple devices, creating a truly spatial experience.

MADE FOR VISION PRO

We built Depthforge exclusively for Apple Vision Pro to deliver the best possible spatial computing experience. By focusing on one platform, we've been able to create an optimized, intuitive interface that takes full advantage of Vision Pro's unique capabilities and Apple's Spatial Photos format.

Join us on this exciting journey into the future of AI-generated spatial photos. Whether you're looking to create stunning visuals, explore new creative possibilities, or simply experience the magic of spatial computing, Depthforge makes it accessible to everyone.
